creativity: Start with a template or make it your own.
description: Build your own composition or rework a template. Keep your projects on your device and take them with you as portable files. No account needed.
showcase: A few ideas to get started
showcaseHint: Drag or swipe to explore the templates.
canvasHint: Combine images, text, video and 3D. Layers and masks let you shape every detail.
effects: See it change as you create.
effectsHint: Blend colors, transform textures and tune each effect in real time. Keep exploring until it feels like you.
motionHint: Start with a motion preset. Refine the movement with keyframes and curves, from subtle loops to bold animations.
agentHint: Create alongside your agent using {{brandName}} commands and project files. Your ideas stay in the lead.
local: No account. Your projects stay with you.
timelapse: Turn your process into a timelapse.
timelapseHint: Replay your creation step by step and share the making-of. Your history keeps 10,000 steps by default.
exportHint: Choose your resolution and preview as you adjust. Export images, timelapses or MP4/WebM videos with sound.
heroDescription: Create still or animated visuals in one simple tool. Combine images, video and 3D with real-time controls.
